            velocity.y -= accellGravity;

            get { return (8 / (density * Mathf.Sqrt(totalVelocity) * Mathf.PI * Mathf.Sqrt(crossSection))); }

        public float accellGravity { get { return (9.8f * Time.fixedDeltaTime); } }
        public float calcVelNextTick { get { return (totalVelocity * Time.fixedDeltaTime - ((ballisticCoeff) * (1.2f) * crossSection * Mathf.Sqrt(totalVelocity) * Mathf.Sqrt(Time.fixedDeltaTime)) / 2 * mass); } }
